detailed_description: The Cookie Policy Generator creates a starter cookie policy template from a few website details and cookie type checkboxes. Enter the website name, website URL, and contact email, choose whether to include functional, analytics, and marketing cookie sections, then generate a Markdown-style policy in the browser. The output includes sample cookie tables, browser settings guidance, opt-out links for included services, and a reminder to customize the template for your own site.
usage_steps: Enter the website name, website URL, and contact email.
Keep essential cookies enabled and choose whether to include functional, analytics, and marketing cookie sections.
Click Generate to create the cookie policy text.
Review the generated template, customize it for your site, and copy the output.
usage_examples: A personal website owner creates a first draft that lists essential and functional cookies.
A small blog adds analytics cookies to include basic Google Analytics sample rows and an opt-out link.
A landing page owner enables marketing cookies to include a Facebook Pixel sample row.
A developer copies the generated Markdown-style text and edits it before publishing a cookie policy page.
